title: Shigofumi Picture Drama
justification: AniList 4173 (SPECIAL, 7 episode(s) from 2008-03-25) is AniDB 5549's special(s) S2-S8, aired 2008-03-25 to 2008-09-26. AniList's PARENT relation names the parent entry, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 5549. The parent's row start 2 end 8 offset -1 puts S2-S8 on TVDB 0x1-0x7 'Picture Drama 1-7' (same dates).
